content.title: Marcel Ruiz (actor)
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Marcel RuizRuiz in 2019OccupationActorYears active2016–present Marcel Ruiz is a Puerto Rican actor, known for his roles as Alex Alvarez in the series One Day at a Time and John Smith in the 2019 film Breakthrough. Ruiz began his career acting in commercials at an early age. He moved to Los Angeles at age nine.[1] Ruiz starred in the reboot of One Day at a Time as the character Alex Alvarez on Netflix (2017-2019) and Pop (2020).[2] In 2019, he starred in Breakthrough, a drama film and true story, portraying the role of John Smith.[3][4] He loves playing sports like basketball and soccer.
